text: わたしも　ポケモンを　そだててるの！

structure.jp: ポケモンを　そだててるの！

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on now; てる is the short spoken form with the い dropped. そだててる = 'am raising'.

patterns.name: 〜の (sentence-final)
patterns.explanation: の at the end of a sentence is a soft way of telling someone something about yourself, used mostly by women and children. そだててるの = 'I'm raising them, you know'.
